Poniżej znajdziesz przykładowy kod Pythona, który wykorzystuje te usługi:

```python
import requests

def tomtom_geocode(query):
    url = f"https://tomtom.com/api/1/geo/{query}/json"
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.json()

def here_directions(origin, destination):
    url = "https://router.hereapi.com/v8/routes"
    params = {
        "transportMode": "car",
        "origin": origin,
        "destination": destination,
        "avoid_features": "[\"tollRoad\"]"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    return response.json()

def open_meteo_forecast(latitude, longitude):
    url = f"https://open-meteo.com/api?latitude={latitude}&longitude={longitude}&current_weather=true&current_weather_forecast=hourly&current_weather_forecast_days=7"
    response = requests.get(url)
    return response.json()

def here_traffic_incidents(location):
    url = "https://data.traffic.hereapi.com/v7/incidents"
    params = {
        "location": location
    }
    response = requests.get(url, params=params)
    return response.json()

# Wykorzystanie usług

```
